base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: The eDP register space is the DPCD (DisplayPort Configuration Data) in the panel Sink, accessed by native AUX read/write over the AUX channel (20-bit address). In addition to the DisplayPort base regions, eDP defines an eDP-specific DPCD block (base 00700h) carrying the eDP Configuration Capability (ASSR / Fast Link Training), backlight registers, and PSR / Remote-Frame-Buffer control. The panel EDID is a separate I2C ROM reached by I2C-over-AUX, not part of the DPCD.

register_access.transport: Native AUX (Manchester-II, ~1 Mbps) over the AUX channel
register_access.transaction: request (4-bit command + 20-bit address + length) / reply (ACK/NACK/DEFER + data)

fields: eDP_CONFIGURATION_CAP (ASSR support, Fast Link Training support, OUI, alternate-scrambler-seed enable)
eDP_GENERAL_CAP (PSR / PSR2 capability, backlight-adjustment capability, frame-buffer capability)
PSR_ENABLE / PSR_CONFIGURATION / PSR_STATUS / PSR2_ENABLE / selective-update (SU) region / RFB control

edid_via_i2c_over_aux.note: Panel EDID is read from the panel's I2C ROM (I2C address A0h) by tunneling I2C over AUX; it is NOT in the DPCD address space.

aux_command_fields.length_encoding: bytes minus one (1..16 bytes per transaction)
